findings.summary: The age gate and content grid do not reflow on a 360px viewport
findings.evidence: The 360x800 screenshots show the age-gate panel wider than the viewport, clipped copy and an off-screen second decision button; after entry, the card grid remains desktop-width and is clipped horizontally.
findings.suggestedFix: Rebuild the gate and grid with intrinsic sizing, wrapping controls, and narrow-container card layouts; verify all actions at 320-360px.

findings.summary: Reduced-motion mode leaves non-essential transitions enabled
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe found 0.5s transitions on the cookie/overlay UI while prefers-reduced-motion: reduce was active.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable or shorten non-essential transitions inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).

findings.summary: Route changes are abrupt full-document swaps
findings.evidence: The representative flow across listing, categories, search and detail pages shows immediate swaps; CSS inspection found no view-transition rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Add same-origin cross-document View Transitions with a reduced-motion fallback for shared navigation and page chrome.

findings.summary: Navigation chrome does not react to scroll position
findings.evidence: Representative listing screenshots show a fixed, visually unchanged navigation bar across a long feed, and CSS inspection found no scroll-state queries or progress affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state container queries or a lightweight sticky-header treatment to preserve orientation without consuming excess space.

findings.summary: A post-consent banner continues to nag users to accept all cookies
findings.evidence: After choosing essential-only cookies and entering, every representative desktop page retains a fixed bottom banner saying some features may be unavailable and suggesting “Accept All Cookies,” obscuring the feed and player.
findings.suggestedFix: Respect the saved essential-only choice without a persistent promotional banner; expose preference changes in a non-obscuring settings entry.

findings.summary: Core overlays use custom modal chrome instead of native dialog primitives
findings.evidence: DOM inspection found zero <dialog> elements and one custom role=dialog age gate; cookie and sign-in overlays are script-managed custom containers.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> for modal flows and Popover for transient UI, preserving focus trapping, Escape handling and light-dismiss semantics.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is absent on many primary controls
findings.evidence: The focus probe reports outline none and no box shadow for cookie buttons, search, primary navigation links and many video links.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a high-contrast :focus-visible indicator on every interactive control and test a full keyboard walk.

findings.summary: Invalid routes and empty-looking searches do not present clear recovery states
findings.evidence: A deliberately nonexistent route returned the normal homepage feed with title “Pornhub” and no 404 message; a nonsense search likewise returned a generic feed with no clear empty-result explanation.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a real 404 status/page with recovery links and make no-result search states explicit with query correction and reset actions.

findings.summary: Loading performance and visual stability miss the Core Web Vitals bar
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 4.4s and CLS 0.739; the trace measured LCP 6.18s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP asset, reserve layout space, and reduce critical dependencies; verify with repeat mobile traces.

findings.summary: Late content causes substantial layout shift
findings.evidence: Lighthouse recorded CLS 0.739 and 15 layout shifts; the mobile layout primitive independently observed CLS 0.102.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve dimensions for images, ads, consent UI and late modules; use stable font fallbacks and aspect-ratio.

findings.summary: The initial load has a large dependency and render-blocking footprint
findings.evidence: HAR captured 171 requests and 3.86MB transferred, including seven very-high-priority parser stylesheets and parser scripts; Lighthouse estimates 370ms render-blocking savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate critical CSS, defer non-critical styles/scripts, and prioritize only the true LCP resource.

findings.summary: The page ships substantial unused and legacy code
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 74KiB unused CSS, 178KiB unused JavaScript and 54KiB legacy-JS savings; 39 scripts load on the gated entry page.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by surface, remove legacy bundles for modern browsers, and load advertising/feature code only after the relevant choice or interaction.

findings.summary: Some controls and frames have mismatched or missing accessible names
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed frame-title and label-content-name-mismatch audits on the entry experience.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every iframe a purpose-specific title and make each accessible name match the visible control label.

findings.summary: The document lacks semantic structure and consistent focus visibility
findings.evidence: The probe found no H1, main or nav landmark; the only visible heading was H3, and many navigation links had no visible focus indicator.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a logical H1-H2 hierarchy and semantic main/nav/footer landmarks, then implement consistent :focus-visible styles.

findings.summary: Viewport policy restricts zoom and narrow reflow is broken
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed meta-viewport for restricting user scaling, while the 360px screenshots show clipped content and controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale/user-scalable restrictions and ensure 400% zoom and 320px reflow retain all content and actions.

findings.summary: The page logs browser errors during load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed the errors-in-console audit during a clean navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix first-party runtime errors and remove or isolate failing third-party calls; enforce an error-free smoke test.

findings.summary: Several assets lack explicit dimensions and deprecated APIs remain
findings.evidence: The image audit found 3 images without width/height; Lighthouse also failed unsized-images and reported two deprecation warnings.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare intrinsic dimensions/aspect ratios and replace deprecated API usage.

findings.summary: The page is not BFCache-safe and raises DevTools issues
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported four BFCache failure reasons, deprecated APIs and Inspector issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unload/BFCache blockers, resolve deprecations and clear DevTools Issues before release.

findings.summary: Public pages use a generic title and omit meta descriptions
findings.evidence: The homepage probe returned title “Pornhub” and no meta description; distinct listing/search/detail surfaces are not differentiated in the captured flow.
findings.suggestedFix: Give each archetype a unique descriptive localized title and meta description.

findings.summary: Indexing and link signals actively undermine crawlability
findings.evidence: The page emits noindex,nofollow; 30 of 124 anchors lack a real href or use javascript:, and Lighthouse failed crawlable-anchors and reported robots.txt invalid with 4,073 errors.
findings.suggestedFix: Decide and document the intended indexing policy; for public pages, serve valid robots rules and real href links while removing accidental noindex/nofollow.

findings.summary: Canonical and indexing signals conflict
findings.evidence: A canonical homepage URL is present, but the page also declares noindex,nofollow and the robots audit fails, making the public localized site’s indexing intent contradictory.
findings.suggestedFix: Align canonical, robots meta, robots.txt, sitemap and hreflang signals for each locale.

findings.summary: Entity and social-preview metadata are absent
findings.evidence: The probe found zero JSON-LD and zero Open Graph tags on a media-rich public page.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate VideoObject/organization metadata and Open Graph/Twitter preview tags matching visible content.

findings.summary: Important browser security controls and one cookie flag are missing
findings.evidence: Headers include HSTS and SAMEORIGIN but omit CSP, nosniff, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; cookie rp is not Secure and all seven cookies use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a tested CSP, nosniff, strict referrer and permissions policies; minimize SameSite=None and mark every HTTPS cookie Secure.

findings.summary: The gated entry page has a large tracking and advertising footprint
findings.evidence: Trackers found 11 third-party origins including Google Tag Manager and DoubleClick; HAR attributes 100 requests and 1.92MB to third parties, including TrafficJunky, before core use.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate non-essential analytics/ads behind consent, audit each vendor, and reduce collection and payloads to the minimum needed.

findings.summary: Defensive policy coverage is incomplete
findings.evidence: The response lacks CSP, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; no frame-ancestors policy or Trusted Types enforcement was observed.
findings.suggestedFix: Add CSP with frame-ancestors and Trusted Types where feasible, plus explicit Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Unknown URLs fail silently into normal content
findings.evidence: The nonexistent test URL showed the homepage feed and no error, retry or recovery state rather than a meaningful 404 response.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve correct HTTP errors with localized recovery actions and test offline/timeout/error states.

findings.summary: Localized layouts rely on physical CSS properties
findings.evidence: The Russian document correctly sets lang=ru, but the platform probe found physical left/right CSS and no logical-property usage, limiting bidi/writing-mode resilience.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace physical spacing/position rules with logical inline/block properties and verify an RTL locale.

findings.summary: Visible numeric abbreviations are not localized consistently
findings.evidence: Russian pages display view counts such as “66.9K” and “2.3M” with English abbreviations amid localized text.
findings.suggestedFix: Format counts and other numbers through Intl.NumberFormat with locale-appropriate compact notation.

findings.summary: The consent experience pressures users after they decline optional cookies
findings.evidence: After “Accept Only Essential Cookies,” a persistent overlay warns that features may be unavailable and directs users toward “Accept All Cookies” across every tested core page.
findings.suggestedFix: Honor the selected consent state without nagging; make changing preferences equally available without degrading core content.

findings.summary: Most images lack responsive sources and use legacy formats
findings.evidence: The image audit found 33/37 without srcset and 22 legacy-format images, while Lighthouse estimates 323KiB image-delivery savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve AVIF/WebP variants with srcset/sizes and preserve explicit dimensions and lazy loading.

findings.summary: The entry experience performs disproportionate background and duplicate work
findings.evidence: The gated page makes 171 requests, including 38 fetch/XHR calls and a duplicate ~900KB homepage fetch, before the user reaches core content.
findings.suggestedFix: Eliminate duplicate document fetches and defer background, analytics and ad work until needed and consented.

findings.summary: Third-party advertising dominates a large initial transfer
findings.evidence: Third parties account for 100 requests and 1.92MB; representative content pages also autoplay a large video advertisement before the selected video.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a strict third-party/media budget, defer ad media until consent and user intent, and avoid autoplay where it is not essential.
